source_name: eUprava Crne Gore — e-government service catalogue (registration services)
why_relevant: The national e-government service catalogue documents which authority owns which register and what the registration/licensing procedure is (e.g. entrepreneur registration, insurance-market services). It is the map of register ownership, useful when a register moves between institutions.

source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore (SCMN) — licences and rules
why_relevant: The Capital Market Authority licenses investment firms and authorised credit institutions providing investment services and maintains a licence register under its rules. Adds a licensed-actor class (investment firms, custodians, fund managers) that CBCG registers do not cover.

source_name: Agencija za nadzor osiguranja (ANO) — insurance market register
why_relevant: Supervisor of insurance companies, foreign branches, brokers and agencies; maintains the register of insurance-market participants. Insurers and bancassurance partners are adjacent buyers of payments/digital-channel technology and appear in partnership announcements.

source_name: Montenegroberza (Montenegro Stock Exchange) — listed issuers
why_relevant: The single ME exchange; its issuer list identifies which banks and financial firms are publicly listed and therefore publish audited annual reports and disclosures — the richest downstream source of case-study and investment detail for those actors.

source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore (Chamber of Economy) — member base and sector groupings
why_relevant: Chamber membership and sector boards (including ICT) provide an industry-side enumeration of vendors and integrators that the statutory registers classify only by NACE code, and its news stream reports partnerships. Complements, rather than replaces, CRPS.

source_name: CBCG — Korisni linkovi: državne institucije
why_relevant: CBCG's own curated link list of Montenegrin state institutions — an efficient, regulator-vetted way to snowball to further register-owning bodies (ministries, agencies, supervisors) that keyword search may miss.

source_name: CBCG — Mapa sajta (site map)
why_relevant: Full CBCG sitemap: the cheapest exhaustive way to discover every register, list and locale path variant (/me/, /eng/, /r/, /c/) without guessing URLs. Essential given the observed duplicate and misspelled register URLs.

source_name: UBCG — Članice udruženja (member bank directory with contacts)
why_relevant: Curated, authoritative list of the ~11-12 licensed banks that constitute the entire addressable buyer set in Montenegro, with addresses, phones and websites — the anchor entity list for the whole ME workstream.

source_name: "Bankar" — UBCG quarterly professional magazine (PDF archive)
why_relevant: The association's own journal carries bank-executive interviews, digital-channel and card/payments articles and vendor-authored pieces — the single richest local-language narrative source on Montenegrin bank technology strategy. PDF back-issues are openly hosted.

source_name: PKCG — Udruženje informacionih i komunikacionih tehnologija (ICT board)
why_relevant: Roster of the ICT supply side chaired by Branimir Bukilić (Data Design) with One d.o.o., MTEL, Telemach, Crnogorski Telekom, Montex-elektronika etc. — the local integrator/vendor bench that competes with or partners on banking IT projects.

source_name: privrednakomora.me — legacy PKCG site (organizational-structure and publications archive)
why_relevant: The older chamber domain still exposes paginated, date-filtered listings of all sectoral associations and an archive of publications that the new komora.me design has partly buried — useful for historical board composition and past events.

source_name: Glasnik Privredne komore Crne Gore (chamber bulletin, PDF)
why_relevant: Monthly/periodic chamber bulletin reporting board sessions, member-company presentations, delegations and signed cooperation agreements — surfaces vendor-bank interactions that never reach the general press.

source_name: ICT Cortex — Montenegrin ICT cluster, member directory
why_relevant: Cluster of ~40 IT firms whose membership visibly includes payments-relevant players (PayTen, POS4.me, Financial Solutions, VG eFISKAL, Euro-Unit, Logate, Data Design, Amplitudo, ZZI, First Line Software) — i.e. the direct competitor/partner bench for a payments vendor in ME.

source_name: ICT Cortex profile on European Cluster Collaboration Platform
why_relevant: EU-maintained structured profile of the cluster (size, sectors, partnerships, EU projects) — a stable, machine-friendly cross-check on cluster claims and a route to EU-funded project consortia involving Montenegrin IT firms.

source_name: AmCham Montenegro — member list
why_relevant: Directory of ~international and local members, explicitly open to banking, insurance and telecom/IT services firms; identifies which banks and technology vendors invest in advocacy and are reachable through a single business network.

source_name: AmCham Montenegro — Digital Transformation Committee & advocacy program
why_relevant: Committee page for the advocacy stream most likely to produce position papers on e-payments, e-signature, cashless economy and grey-economy/fiscalisation — policy documents that name the vendors and banks pushing each agenda.

source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC) — members and White Book
source_subtype: foreign investors association + annual position publication
why_relevant: Council of ~43 leading foreign investors (>30% of GDP) including the foreign-owned banks; the annual White Book is a member-authored assessment of the business/regulatory environment with explicit sector chapters — high-signal, citable, and names the member companies.

source_name: Unija poslodavaca Crne Gore (UPCG) / Montenegrin Employers Federation
why_relevant: Representative employers' federation (BusinessEurope member) covering entrepreneurs through large systems; its board and sector-association structure and social-dialogue positions identify large corporate buyers and reveal cost/regulatory pressures (fiscalisation, cash handling) shaping payments demand.

source_name: Montenegro Business Alliance (Montenegro Biznis Alijansa, MBA)
why_relevant: Private-sector advocacy alliance claiming 500+ companies and ~40% of GDP; useful as a second, non-chamber roster of corporate buyers and as a barrier/regulation-reform voice. No live own-domain directory located, so profiled via third-party registries.

source_name: German-Montenegrin Business Club (DMW / Njemački poslovni klub)
why_relevant: The German business association presence in Montenegro (Montenegro has no full AHK chamber). Membership and events channel German/DACH suppliers — relevant for German banking-IT vendors entering ME — and its committees mirror AmCham's advocacy structure.

source_name: Asocijacija menadžera Crne Gore (AMM) — membership and Digital Transformation Board
why_relevant: Managers' association whose published member list and named Digital Transformation Board (Čikom, Mtel, Finance Plus, ZZI, Roaming Networks, government IT advisers) maps the decision-maker network across banks, telcos and IT suppliers; also initiated the new CFO Association.

source_name: CFO Asocijacija Crne Gore (Association of Financial Directors) — newly formed
why_relevant: Newly constituted national CFO association (AMM initiative) — a forming buyer community for treasury, payments and finance-automation vendors. Currently only traceable through press coverage; watch for an own domain and member roster.
